evidence.supporting_text: Breaking Silos: Promoting Systems Thinking through Multi-Sector Environmental Education Partnerships Shaghig Chaparian, New York University, sc8792@nyu.edu Abstract: This conceptual paper explores the integration of Systems Thinking (ST) into Environmental Education (EE) to address interconnected socio- environmental challenges, drawing on theories of critical pedagogy, Cultural -Historical Activity Theory (CHAT), and Situated Learning Theory (SLT).
